title: FAST-7C: Dedupe and Lineage Validation Gate for Backlog Planning Runs

sourcePlanning.title: Plan backlog replenishment after major backlog depletion alert

validationChecklist.command: python -c 'import json, pathlib; fp="backlog-under-threshold-restore-10"; artifacts=pathlib.Path("planning/backlog-triggers").glob("*.json"); seen=[p for p in artifacts if json.loads(p.read_text()).get("triggerFingerprint")==fp]; print("Recent planning runs checked (0): none" if len(seen)==1 else f"Recent planning runs checked ({max(len(seen)-1, 0)}): collision")'

validationChecklist.observedResult: Lineage fields present: triggerFingerprint, triggerArtifactId, dedupeEvidence

rejectionCriteria.action: Gate rejects ticket issuance when candidate handoff is missing any required lineage field, including dedupeEvidence lines.

qaHandoff.validationRule: QA must perform verbatim replay of each listed command and confirm observedResult matches the recorded output with no additional interpretation.

gateBehavior.passPath: When all checklist commands replay with exact observedResult matches, backlog-replenishment ticket emission is allowed.
gateBehavior.failPath: If any checklist command fails, output mismatches, or required lineage fields are missing, issuance is rejected and operator escalation is required.

boundaries: Validation gate executes before any backlog-replenishment ticket emission.
Task-store binding and lineage evidence are treated as hard preconditions.
Ticket emission remains blocked on any dedupe or lineage validation failure.
interfaces: Input: trigger artifact and task-store backing data.
Output: reproducible checklist records and binary pass/fail gate decision.
risks: Mis-bound task-store paths can make open-task checks non-replayable.
Missing lineage fields can allow untraceable downstream handoffs.
implementationReadyDecisions: Open-task check is bound to the authoritative FAST task-store root.
Lineage fields triggerFingerprint, triggerArtifactId, and dedupeEvidence are mandatory.
Gate fails closed when replay output diverges from recorded evidence.
